title: Chapter 59
text:
There were plenty of job opportunities in the West Capital. Players could join the Stardragon Army at the sentry post. There were also some gangs in the slums of District 8 that were recruiting only men, which fully exposed the discrimination against women in the workplace. There were also countless daily quests in the shops along the streets. Players could trigger daily quests such as' Missing Wallet 'or' Catching Cat on a Tree 'by grabbing onto a random passerby. There were also many shops that were hiring part-time workers that could earn them money. This confirmed Sleepy Winter's speculation that the new map was full of opportunities.

Of course, the Western Capital was a high-level map, and there were many places that weren't open to beginners. Sleepy Winter and the other two also ran into problems at times. Rainy Kim had heard that she was going to the Western Capital Academy, but she was rejected at the entrance. Twinkle Fried Rice had gone to the first district, but he was chased out by the sentry at gunpoint. He had almost lost his virginity.

The next day, Sleepy Winter, Rainy Kim, and Twinkle Fried Rice decided to join the Stardragon Army and become soldiers. They finally unlocked the combat class [Recruit], and they had a lot of fun with the various training quests. Their faction had also changed from 'Stardragon Nation' to 'Stardragon Army', and their status had also changed to [Private].

Sleepy Winter didn't forget about Frenzied Sword as well. They added each other as friends while they were in the car. Sleepy Winter kindly told Frenzied Sword that he could join the army, but Frenzied Sword only said a few perfunctory words before hanging up the call. This made Sleepy Winter gloomy. Thinking that Frenzied Sword wasn't interested in joining the army, he shook his head and ignored him.

What Sleepy Winter didn't know was that Mad Blade didn't care about the opportunity he mentioned. He was completely focused on hugging Han Xiao's thick thighs.

In order to test the limits of the quests, Han Xiao continuously gave Mad Blade all sorts of quests, including 'Kick ten passers-by', 'Take off the pants of a patrolling policeman', 'Spin around like a little swan for five minutes', 'Stick up your butt and shout' Stand still 'three times', and so on …

After testing it out, Han Xiao was finally certain that as long as his reward could reach the standard of difficulty, he could issue any mission with no restrictions.

Mad Blade, on the other hand, felt like he was about to die. These missions were full of bad taste, making him more and more terrified of Han Xiao. Just being stared at by Han Xiao made him feel a chill rush from his crotch to his head.

However, the EXP that Han Xiao gave was several times more than the Beginner's Quest. For the sake of the EXP, Mad Blade personally shattered his pure and flawless heart and followed Han Xiao's orders.

Why are my eyes filled with hot tears? It's a desperate accusation against this hardcore world.

The reward of abandoning his principles allowed him to level up quickly. He learned various basic skills from Han Xiao and contributed a lot of EXP to Han Xiao.

Although the closed beta was out of Han Xiao's expectations, it did not affect the overall situation. The closed beta players scattered all over Blue Star were just a drop in the ocean compared to the entire planet's population. If the players wanted to affect the situation of the novice planet, they would need to grow for a long period of time. The closed beta only lasted for twelve days, so they could not do much.

A small, inconspicuous cyclone on the ocean would accumulate to become a storm that would sweep across the entire world.

The closed beta players were all poor and did not have much money on them. However, in the long run, the players were the biggest consumer group.

Han Xiao controlled the EXP from the Beginner's Quest. He gave more EXP than the Beginner's Quest, but it was limited. He wanted to help Mad Blade grow slightly. This was his plan. Mad Blade would rely on his missions and the equipment he bought from him to perform well before everyone else grew up. Even if Mad Blade wanted to keep a low profile, the club he belonged to would not allow it. They would definitely publicize it and attract other players to be curious about Mad Blade's opportunity. This would increase his potential customer base, and when the time came, he would be drowned in EXP and cash. Mad Blade wanted to monopolize him. Han Xiao was very clear about this, but he did not care. It was human nature.

Time passed quickly.

…

Countdown to Open Beta: 126 days, 11 hours, 32 minutes

Other than creating high-explosive ammunition to gain EXP, Han Xiao used his free time to browse the players' forums.

The players' forums were the authoritative platform for players to communicate with each other. Usually, they would set up stalls and wait for revival to pass the time. Now, only the closed beta players were posting.

"The women in Blue Star Raylan are so beautiful!"

"Urgently requesting players to form a team to challenge the Yellow Sand Bandits. Location: Longsong Star – Fallen Dragon Valley. Coordinates …"

"Captured the scenery of Brighton Star Magic Floating City."

"Randomly turned into a tentacle monster. Asking how to change race. Waiting online!"

"F * ck, I want to change with you. I want to be a tentacle monster!"

Most of the posts were to ask for help and share information. Some guilds also showed their progress to increase their reputation.

There were more than a dozen Beginner's Planets, including Magic Civilization, Ancient Civilization, Sci-Fi Civilization, Martial Arts Civilization, Religious Civilization, and so on. There were many races and different social forms.

The most popular one was Winterfrost Star, the territory of the Void Demons. It was one of the strongholds of the Extinguish Army. Most of the players there were not humans.

Although their philosophy of "extinguishing the fire of civilization" could be justified, every time he saw the name of the Extinguish Army, Han Xiao still felt a slight pain in his balls.

Suddenly, a new post appeared and was instantly pinned to the top, attracting his attention.

"The first B-Level Quest!"

Han Xiao was surprised. He remembered that the first B-Level Quest appeared after the open beta. How could anyone come in contact with a quest of this level during the closed beta?

Han Xiao clicked on it out of curiosity and saw a bunch of players crazily discussing below.

"You must be kidding. I haven't even seen a D-Level Quest before."

"You're an idiot. The post has pictures and the truth!"

"It must be photoshopped. Otherwise, why would they only show the name of the quest and not the content?"

"Are you kidding? Are they going to let you accept the quest?"

"It must be very difficult. We haven't even passed the novice stage. How can we complete it?"

"The poster is from the Guild of Gods. They are elites. Maybe they have a way."

"Can anyone tell us which planet this is?"

"I'll laugh and rub your heads."

"Sorry, my Wang Cai has run out."

"The first post is talking about teenage craziness. The second post is hard. The third post is itchy. The fourth post is erect. The fifth post is undressing. In order to report to the sixth post, perky ass, shoot the seventh post. The eighth post is hot in the chest. The ninth post is strong in the kidneys. The tenth post, don't hesitate. Straight in with the penis. Flipping the eleventh post. The twelfth post is like a spear. Looking down, the thirteenth lady appears. "

“666666”

"Unexpected Literary Genius!"

"I've been 'unexpected'?"

"Idiots, this is an old joke from decades ago!"

Han Xiao smiled knowingly as he reminisced about the past. He carefully read through the dozens of pages of replies one by one before moving on to the content.

The post only had a screenshot of the quest name, and that screenshot made Han Xiao squint.

"B-Level Quest: [Investigate Zero]."

Han Xiao immediately thought of the Germinal Organization. He looked at the poster again. It was an official ID, the Guild of Gods.

"The guild of the Temple of Gods?"

The Temple of Gods was a giant in the professional circle. They had produced countless gods and had their own industry chain. Han Xiao had a grudge with them before. He had taken a revenge mission and killed the guild leader of the Guild of Gods several times. He had taken screenshots of his corpse in various embarrassing poses and posted them on the forums. The title was in the style of the WC Shock Department. "Shocking! Why did the guild leader of the Guild of Gods … Women cry when they see it, men fall silent when they see it! " After making a quick buck, he was hunted down by the entire Guild of Gods for a month.

"I miss the feeling of killing players …" Han Xiao sighed and turned to look at Mad Blade.

Mad Blade froze. He could feel the malice in Han Xiao's eyes. He was so scared that he did not dare to move. He stood rooted to the ground like a wooden puppet, sweating profusely.

Han Xiao shook his head and thought to himself.

In his previous life, the Guild of Gods had joined the Germinal Organization and was one of the largest player guilds there. It seemed that the situation had not changed.

Even a group of closed beta players could receive the mission to investigate him. It seemed that the Germinal Organization was determined to kill him. Han Xiao's eyes flashed with a hint of coldness.

To the current players, it was extremely difficult to avoid the eyes and ears of Division 13 and find Han Xiao, who could beat them up. No wonder it was classified as a B-grade mission. Only by relying on the advantage of numbers would they have a chance.

However, the Guild of Gods did not seem to lack people.

Suddenly, Han Xiao knew which Germinal Organization base he should choose for his next target.

…

The Guild of Gods had fifteen closed beta players, which fully demonstrated what it meant to be a privileged class. The president and vice president personally led some of the core experts into the closed beta. After some discussion, they expressed their preference for technology on the system's questionnaire.

Their thinking was simple. Since the setting of Galaxy was the stars of the universe, technology had to be the main theme. Due to this choice, the Guild of Gods was assigned to the Blue Star and quickly collected the money to buy the map.

After careful consideration, the president, Jupiter, chose the Germinal Organization as the initial faction. Coincidentally, there was a Germinal Organization base near Crow Forest Town where they were born.

Jupiter felt that the Germinal Organization should be the strongest faction. It was an enemy of all the countries on the planet and could still exist peacefully. As for the NPC faction's ideology, it had nothing to do with them. Only a person with terminal internet addiction would care about the life and death of a group of NPCs. They all needed to be treated by Yang Technologies.

The reality did not disappoint the Guild of Gods. After joining the Germinal Organization, they were brought to a new scene called the Dark Crow Valley Base. They officially became low-level members of the Germinal Organization and received a large number of training missions.

The biggest surprise was the B-grade mission, [Investigate Zero]. Even the Guild of Gods did not expect to receive such a huge reward. The reward was very tempting.

The mission notification was very simple. It only stated that the mission target, Zero, was in the territory of Stardragon.

At this time, the Guild of Gods was in a meeting to discuss how to complete the mission.

Jupiter said in a deep voice, "This is the first B-grade mission. It does not seem to require combat. With our current level, it is possible to complete it. The reward is very generous, and it will allow us to be ahead of all the other players. Whether we can suppress the other guilds in the future will depend on whether we can seize this opportunity!"

"We only know that Zero is in Stardragon. The range is so large that it is like looking for a needle in a haystack. The probability of finding an NPC is too low. Furthermore, there is not much time left in the closed beta, so to complete this mission, we can only place our hopes on the open beta. Before that, we should do a preliminary investigation," said the core member, Poseidon.

Everyone nodded. There were different opinions, and ideas were suggested one after another.

Jupiter liked to dig for hidden information. He pondered and said, "The mission notification vaguely states that the Germinal Organization and Zero are enemies. If we capture or even kill Zero, will there be additional rewards?"

"That makes sense. As expected of Old Pig."

"Then it will probably be an A-grade mission." Poseidon was not optimistic.

"There is no mission that is impossible. We just haven't found a shortcut yet." Jupiter knocked on the conference table. "The open beta will be a week after the closed beta. During this time, the other elders will have to discuss a way to continue this mission in the open beta. This will be a breakthrough."

Shiva said proudly, "When the open beta comes, we will have the support of the guild's resources. If even we cannot complete this mission, no one can."

"That's right." Jupiter nodded.

Poseidon suggested. "Using the strength of other players is much faster than us finding it ourselves."

Jupiter's eyes lit up. "That makes sense. Post a post about Zero's appearance and offer a reward. As long as there is a valuable clue, we will give him the money."

The Temple of Gods was a rich and powerful club.

PS: Thank you for your generous reward 160822152201168!
